author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for The Ninth Legion, a real-time war strategy game developed by CaCaw! Players will manage relationships and the war at hand as Rome's long-lost legion in their final days during the Legio IX Hispana. The Ninth Legion is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: The Ninth Legion - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Build your castle, hunt for blood, rise in power. Check out the latest V Rising trailer for the gothic open-world survival action RPG developed by Stunlock Studios. The new action-packed V Rising trailer showcases version 1.0 gameplay. Awaken as a vampire, build your castle, hunt for blood, and rise in power in a gothic world. Play solo or online with others as you fight for dominance. V Rising is available now on Steam and PlayStation 5 (PS5).
title: V Rising - Official 1.0 Gameplay Trailer | Big Break Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Jump Space is a mission-based co-op PvE for 1-4 players, where you are the crew of a spaceship. Transition seamlessly from crewing the ship to on-foot exploration and space walks. Explore, upgrade, and survive intense encounters in deep space together. The new Jump Space trailer details what you can expect from the Anniversary update, which features an upgraded difficulty level, reworked inventory, and more. 

Jump Space is out now in Early Access on PC (Steam) and Xbox Series X/S.
title: Jump Space - Official Anniversary Update Trailer | Big Break Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at multiplayer gameplay from Dinolords in this latest trailer for the game that combines real-time strategy, city-building and action RPG combat in the genre hybrid Hack’n’Strat. Dinolords will be available on PC. A multiplayer demo will be available on October 19, 2026. Playtest signups are now open on the game's Steam page.

In Dinolords, build your stronghold, command human and dinosaur armies and fight as the lord shaping a new age of warfare.
title: Dinolords - Official Multiplayer Demo Trailer | Big Break Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get ready to take on the Swarm and get another look at DarkSwarm in this latest trailer. DarkSwarm is a top-down tactical co-op shooter for 1-4 players. Deploy to lost colonies, face thousands of enemies, and extract valuable resources through procedurally generated levels. Combine four distinct classes and watch your fire! 

DarkSwarm will be available in Early Access on PC. A Closed Alpha will be available on November 3, 2026. You can request access now if you're interested.
title: DarkSwarm - Official Closed Alpha Trailer | Big Break Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
"Take your fate in your hands." Check out this cinematic trailer for Valheim, the collaborative exploration and survival game for 1-10 players, set in a procedurally generated afterlife inspired by Viking culture. The new trailer features an original song composed, produced, and performed by Miracle of Sound's Gavin Dunne.

In Valheim, battle, build, and conquer your way to a saga worthy of Odin’s patronage in Valheim. Valheim version 1.0 is available now on PC, Linux, Mac, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch 2.
title: Valheim - Official Cinematic Trailer | Big Break Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the latest Teardown trailer for the voxel-based adventure game and what to expect with the upcoming Rally mode. In Teardown's Rally mode, players go pedal to the metal through a series of unique race maps, packed with explosives, hammers, and environmental dangers to use against other drivers.

Teardown is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Teardown - Official Rally Mode Announce Trailer | Big Break Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Full controller support is coming to As We Descend. Watch the latest As We Descend video for this apocalyptic roguelike deckbuilder with squad sculpting and deep tactics. The new developer video gives another look at gameplay and what to expect with the controller support update. 

In As We Descend, recruit the right units and outmaneuver titanic foes on dangerous expeditions. Build up allies and resources in the feudal Vault-City. Can you survive all the perils that await the last bastion of humanity? 

As We Descend is out now in Steam Early Access.
title: As We Descend - Official Developer Update Video | Big Break Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Lightyear Frontier gets a new trailer showcasing its sci-fi world and a version 1.0 release date. Watch the latest Lightyear Frontier trailer for the open-world farming adventure game. The version 1.0 release will bring a new update, featuring new endgame content, quality-of-life enhancements, mech upgrades, and more.

In Lightyear Frontier you use your powerful trusty mech to farm on a large beautiful alien planet. Settle your homestead, farm and deliver produce to remote colonies, gather and manage resources, build, craft, explore, expand, improve your mech, meet neighbors, and make a place to call your own.

Lightyear Frontier is out now in Early Access, and version 1.0 will be available on PC via Steam and Xbox Series X/S on November 4, 2026.
title: Lightyear Frontier - Official Version 1.0 Release Date Trailer | Big Break Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Tour the office and meet the development team at She Was Such a Good Horse for a behind-the-scenes look at the studio of the upcoming third-person roguelite game, Into the Unwell. Whack-and-slash your inner demons in Into the Unwell, set in a rubber-hose-fuelled fever dream! Play 1-3 players as one of several flawed and heavily medicated misfits. 

Into the Unwell will be available on PC in 2027.
title: Into the Unwell - Official Developer Behind-the-Scenes Video | Big Break Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a fresh look at combat and the world of Huntdown: Overtime in this trailer for the roguelite prequel game. Corporations turned crime-infested streets into profit margins for bounty hunters and John Sawyer is going to make a killing. Hunt, die, upgrade, repeat in Huntdown: Overtime, where every strategic upgrade strips away more flesh and builds a cybernetic fighter one chrome limb at a time.

Huntdown: Overtime is out now in Steam Early Access.
title: Huntdown: Overtime - Official Trailer | Big Break Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Join community manager Hamish Bode at developer Chief Rebel for an update on the 1.0 full release of Fellowship in this trailer for the multiplayer dungeon adventure game. The new Fellowship trailer breaks down what to expect with the update, including onboarding experiences, more active queues, and more rewards.

Fellowship is out now in Early Access on PC.
title: Fellowship - Official Road to 1.0 Overview Trailer | Big Break Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Theme park fun awaits! Check out the latest Goat Simulator 3 trailer for the third-person sandbox adventure game to see what's coming with the third major expansion, Ticket to Dizzyworld. The Goat Simulator 3: Ticket to Dizzyworld DLC will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox, Windows, Epic Games Store, and Steam on November 19, 2026.

Welcome to Dizzyworld. An immersive goat-themed baa-musement park, letting you reach higher ups and downs than your mood swings. Take a well-deserved break and feel the g(oat)-force on the many thrilling rides the park has to offer, turn innocent visitors into baalloons, and trade Dizzy Tokens for sweet rewards.
title: Goat Simulator 3 - Official Ticket to Dizzyworld Trailer | Big Break Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the teaser trailer for Rock and Stone!, an upcoming Deep Rock Galactic card game. Rock and Stone! A DRG Card Game is a fun, fast-paced card game where players slam down hidden cards, play mind games, and bet against "friends". Beware of glyphids and chaos.

Rock and Stone! A DRG Card Game's crowdfunding launch is coming in 2027. You can follow along on Kickstarter now to learn more if you're interested.
title: Rock and Stone! A DRG Card Game - Official Teaser Trailer | Big Break Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Begraved is a scary co-op adventure where you loot cursed crypts, dodge traps, and flee from things that should not move. Escape with treasures snatched from the dead. Decorate your hideout, uncover buried secrets, and remember: the Taxman always comes for his due. Watch the latest Begraved trailer to see gameplay and more ahead of its launch on PC via Steam.
title: Begraved - Official Trailer | Big Break Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Release Date Trailer for Flea Madness, a third-person action shooter developed by Missset. Players will head into battle as a mere flea to secure objectives, dish out damage, and ensure victory at all costs. Flea Madness is launching on November 12 for PC (Steam).
title: Flea Madness - Official Release Date Trailer

description: The Dahlia, La Pantera update for Dead as Disco is out now in PC Early Access. In addition to the new boss, the Dahlia update adds a full new story level, two new arenas, eight new challenges, a new enemy type, new abilities, cosmetics, dance moves, and more.
title: Dead As Disco - Official Dahlia Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at gameplay, building, and more from Moonfrost in this trailer for the upcoming life sim RPG. Moonfrost will be available in Early access on Steam on October 12, 2026.

In a world ravaged by meteor storms, begin your cosy yet epic journey as a Frost Hunter in Moonfrost! Rebuild a shattered village whilst enjoying a life of farming, crafting and befriending charming neighbours as you uncover the dark truths behind the mysterious Second Moon.
title: Moonfrost - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer

The Legend of California is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: The Legend of California - Official Alpha 4 Features Trailer

description: Take a look at the Blood Testament Chapter 2 Trailer for Hunt: Showdown 1896, the hit first-person action shooter developed by Crytek Studios. Chapter 2 of the Blood Testament kicks off on October 6 for Hunt: Showdown 1896 on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Hunt: Showdown 1896 - Official Blood Testament Chapter 2 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at gameplay from Pixel Washer in this latest trailer for the upcoming action sim game. In Pixel Washer, grab your power washer and scrub pixelated worlds squeaky clean! Play as an adorable piggy, blast away grime, upgrade your gear, and restore a grubby town to its former glory in this cozy, almost zen-like game. Pixel Washer will be available in Early Access on PC on October 15, 2026.
title: Pixel Washer - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Malhaar trailer for this upcoming musical slice-of-life RPG where you play as a musician and luthier who has just arrived in the mystical city that lives and breathes music. Befriend locals, solve puzzles and unravel the mysterious stories of the lingering musical spirits that only appear during the season of the fireflies. Malhaar will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
title: Malhaar - Official Demo Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

description: Check out the Tomb Raider: Secrets of Ni’ihau Trailer for The Crew Motorfest, the hit arcade open-world racing game developed by Ubisoft. Swerve through derelict tombs in Tomb Raider: Secrets of Ni’ihau for The Crew Motorfest, launching on October 7 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: The Crew Motorfest - Official Tomb Raider: Secrets of Ni’ihau Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a closer look at the new Ghost Crewmate role, the Influencer, in this latest Among Us trailer for the game of teamwork and betrayal for 4-15 players...in space! The new Among Us trailer details what you can expect from the Influencer Ghost Crewmate role, which features the Message ability, where you can send images to living Crewmates to help them catch the Imposter(s). However, you must choose wisely as your fellow Crewmates might misunderstand what you're trying to say. 

Update v190.0 of Among Us is out now, bringing the new Ghost Crewmate role to the game.
title: Among Us - Official New Influencer Role Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Life and death are yours to command with Overwatch's newest Hero, Doctrine. Check out the latest Overwatch gameplay trailer to see the Support Hero, Doctrine, in action. Overwatch is available now on PC and consoles. Season 5: A Grim Doctrine of Overwatch begins on October 6, 2026.

Doctrine can manipulate life itself to heal allies and damage enemies with the help of his Eternal Scepter. 

From the trailer's official description: Dodge incoming fire with his Shrouded Momentum ability, and send out your Invigorating Drones to an ally for increased attack speed and healing.

Doctrine’s Infuse takes things to the next level by adding extra power to whichever ability he uses next, like gaining free-flight when infusing his Shrouded Momentum or piercing damage when infusing his next Eternal Scepter attack. Finally, unleash his Ultimate, Deliverance, to grant allies overhealth while reducing the maximum health of your enemies.
title: Overwatch - Official Doctrine: New Hero Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Dicevaders is available now on Steam, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2. Watch the Dicevaders launch trailer to see gameplay and more from this dice-based roguelike deckbuilder about leading the ultimate alien invasion. Set in the StarVaders universe, draft and manipulate the dice row, build an unstoppable army, and unleash adrenaline-pumping combos through powerful synergies and strategic play.
title: Dicevaders - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Podracers Trailer for Star Wars: Galactic Racer, an arcade action racing game developed by Fuse Games. Players can get behind the controls of the legendary Podracer with incredible speed and velocity, requiring immense strategy to attain victory in any race. Harness the speed of the Podracers in Star Wars: Galactic Racer, launching on October 6 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer - Official Podracers Trailer

description: Nivalis Nights is out now on Steam. Explore the neon city of Nivalis Nights in this launch trailer for this cyberpunk life sim game. Grow your business, manage restaurants and nightclubs, make friends and enemies, buy and decorate apartments, go fishing and maybe even find love in Nivalis, the city that stretches from the ocean to the clouds.
title: Nivalis Nights - Official Launch Trailer

description: Don't miss the Roxy Character Teaser Trailer for Zenless Zone Zero, the hit action RPG developed by HoYoverse. Players can get a brief look at Roxy's backstory as she makes her debut in the world of Zenless Zone Zero. Roxy launches into Zenless Zone Zero on September 30 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, iOS, Android, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Zenless Zone Zero - Official Roxy Character Teaser Trailer

description: Take a look at the Launch Trailer for Way of the Hunter 2, an open-world first-person hunting simulation game developed by Nine Rocks Games. Players will explore scenic locations across North America and Africa to stalk animals, make use of a variety of weapons, and experience the thrill of the hunt with a loyal canine companion. Way of the Hunter 2 is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Way of the Hunter 2 - Official Launch Trailer

description: Join the team at Creative Assembly and their development partners at Mataboo for a deep dive into the updates and enhancements available in Total War: Shogun 2 - Complete Edition, including new and improved graphics, lighting, textures, UI improvements, the addition of modern controls, and more. Total War: Shogun 2 - Complete Edition will be available on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store) and Xbox on PC on October 13, 2026.

description: Check out the Reveal Trailer for A Game About Digging A Hole Together, a multiplayer digging game developed by Mipumi Games. Players will join forces to carve out a plot of land and dig deeper and deeper into the ground below. Take on different terrain, attain upgrades, and make use of a variety of tools along the way. A Game About Digging A Hole Together is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Xbox on PC).
title: A Game About Digging A Hole Together - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Minecraft Dungeons 2 is available now on Nintendo Switch 1, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Windows, and Steam. Watch the Minecraft Dungeons 2 launch trailer for this action-adventure RPG sequel to see gameplay and a peek at your adventure. 

In Minecraft Dungeons 2, step through the rift and fight where no hero has been before: the Sift, an uncharted dimension teeming with threats, mysteries, and breathtaking beauty. Gear up and customize your gameplay to face your toughest enemies yet in explosive battles. Brave the unknown as a lone hero, team up with friends in couch, online and mixed co-op, or find allies through matchmaking. The illagers’ plot is already underway, and their cruelty is only matched by their power. Stop them – or lose the Overworld to their corruption.
title: Minecraft Dungeons 2 - Official Launch Trailer

description: Get a look at the Depths of the Damned Update Launch Trailer for Warhammer 40,000: Darktide, a first-person action shooter developed by Fatshark. Players will take on the dangers of the Spillway, a place below Tertium where chaos festers. Take out all manner of enemies with new weapons and face the Psyker boss with the new update. The Depths of the Damned Update for Warhammer 40,000: Darktide is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, and PC (Steam).
title: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide - Official Depths of the Damned Update Launch Trailer

Enjoy ray tracing in all modes of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, launching on October 23 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

description: Take a look at the Launch Trailer for Gothic 2 Complete Classic, a complete edition of the classic action RPG developed by Piranha Bytes. Players will embody the Nameless Hero once more as the world succumbs to chaos and disarray. Make use of a suite of weapons and spells, select dialogue choices in key situations to guide the story, and explore what the sprawling world has to offer. Gothic 2 Complete Classic is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Gothic 2 Complete Classic - Official Launch Trailer

description: Tiny Flock is available now on Meta and Steam VR. Check out the Tiny Flock launch trailer for this cozy, physics-based VR puzzle game from the creators of Human Fall Flat. The new Tiny Flock trailer showcases gameplay and the cute sheep you'll lead to new pastures. Help guide your adorable wayward sheep through beautiful hand-crafted diorama puzzles using the environment around you to get them to safety!
title: Tiny Flock - Official Launch Trailer

description:
Get a closer look at gameplay from Dog in the Machine in this launch trailer for the turn-based tactics deckbuilding roguelike game. Dog in the Machine is available now on PC.

Train an AutoDog to escape a dystopian mecha-city in this tactical roguelite. Craft powerful modular attacks, plan every move with stress-free real-time previews, and unleash devastating chain reactions to outsmart hordes of killjoy robots!
title: Dog in the Machine - Official Launch Trailer

description:
The adventure continues in Season One: Return of the Thieves Guild of The Elder Scrolls Online. Check out the latest The Elder Scrolls Online Season One: Return of the Thieves Guild trailer to see what's coming to the RPG, featuring new challenges and limited-time rewards. Explore the secrets and solve the perplexing puzzles of the Nowhere Vault (beginning today, September 28, 2026). This season, listen for rumors and uncover hidden stories across Tamriel. The new season also brings player experience improvements to discover. Additionally, battle above and below the depths during the limited-time High Seas of Tamriel event, which runs from September 30 to October 14, 2026). 

The Elder Scrolls Online Season One is now live (September 28) until October 21, 2026 on PC, Mac, Steam, Xbox Series X/S, Xbox One, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and PlayStation 4 (PS4).

Get more information on the upcoming World of Warcraft: Forever, launching on November 4 for PC.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Flipping is Hard gets a new teaser trailer showcasing multiplayer features, gameplay, and a release date. Check out the latest Flipping is Hard teaser trailer for this upcoming physics-based co-op rage platformer game. Flipping is Hard will be available on PC via Steam on October 16, 2026.

In Flipping is Hard, you are Flippy, a Flippia brick phone thrown out with the trash. Your (rather irresponsible) boy Jeff is at the top of the Trashlands, a mountain of forgotten toys, gadgets and childhood memories. You can't walk. You can only flip, end over end, through storm drains, candy hills, neon grids, and refrigerators. One bad flip can cost you an hour.
title: Flipping is Hard - Official Teaser Trailer

description:

The new trailer teases the iconic Freddy Krueger from Nightmare on Elm Street, Five Nights at Freddy's, and more horror surprises. Fortnitemares returns to Fortnite on October 1, 2026.

#Fortnite #Fortnitemares2026 #Gaming

The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store).

#TheWitcher3WildHuntRemastered #Gaming #IGN

description:
Check out this latest look at God of War Laufey, the new entry into the Norse Saga of God of War from Sony Santa Monica. Play as Laufey for the first time, portrayed by Deborah Ann Woll, a warrior and wife to Kratos, who had passed in the early moments of God of War 2018, but she awakens in Everywhen, a realm that seems to pull from several different cultures. Wield her power as she fights against dark forces inside of Everywhen as she seeks to preserve the plans put in place to protect her family. 
God of War Laufey launches February 16th for PlayStation 5.
